Why I Still Write Letters

November 20, 2018

My grandmother wrote me a letter every month until she died, and I kept all of them in a shoebox under the bed.

A letter is slow on purpose. You can’t take it back, and you can’t edit it once it’s sealed, which is the whole point.

Somebody else's famous line about letters.

What changed

Nothing, really. I still write them, and people still seem surprised to get one.
